****POTENTIAL POLLUTION*** THE RP IS REPORTING A POTENTIAL POLLUTION OF GASOLINE DUE TO A CAPSIZED VESSEL. RP STATED THAT THE FISHING VESSEL WAS DIW (DEAD IN THE WATER) WHEN A TUG BOAT STRUCK THE VESSEL. RP STATED THERE WERE THREE (3) POBS AT THE TIME OF THE INCIDENT. RP STATED THERE WAS AN ESTIMATED 15-20 GALLONS OF FUEL ON BOARD AT THE TIME. **RP STATED THE CAPSIZED VESSEL IS AFLOAT AND DID NOT TAKE ON WATER. THE VESSEL WAS TIED OFF TO SHORE BUT HAS NOT BEEN RECOVERED AT THIS TIME.

Report DescriptionTHE CALLER IS REPORTING THAT ON FEBRUARY 01, 2023 THERE WAS A RELEASE OF AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF MERCURY ONTO THE CARPET OF A PRIVATE RESIDENCE. THE CALLER STATES THAT THE SRP HAD A JAR OF MERCURY AT THERE RESIDENCE, WHEN THE RESIDENCE WAS BROKEN INTO AND THE JAR OF MERCURY WAS SMASHED. THE CALLER STATES THAT THE SRP ATTEMPTED TO CLEAN THE MERCURY WITH A VACUUM, BUT DID NOT DISPOSE OF IT PROPERLY. ON MARCH 24, 2023 THE SRP REPORTED TO AUGUSTA UNIVERSITY HOSPITAL SUFFERING FROM SHORTNESS OF BREATH, PAIN AND WEAKNESS. THE SRP WENT THROUGH A FULL SCREENING AND ON MARCH 26, 2023, THE PHYSICIAN DISCOVERED HIGH LEVELS OF MERCURY IN THE SRP"S BLOOD. ON APRIL 01, 2023 THE SRP RETURNED TO THE HOSPITAL WITH SIMILAR SYMPTOMS AND WAS ADMITTED FOR MERCURY POISONING. THE PHYSICIAN THEN REPORTED THE INCIDENT TO GEORGIA POISON CENTER.
